text: On August 14th, as the Great Nation of Pakistan celebrates the 79th Auspicious Anniversary of Independence, on behalf of myself, Government and Nation of the Islamic Republic of Iran, I extend my Warmest Greetings to the Government & Nation of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
translated_text: 8 月 14 日，在伟大的巴基斯坦庆祝独立 79 周年之际，我谨代表我个人、伊朗伊斯兰共和国政府和民族，向巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国政府和民族致以最热烈的问候。
